Subject: Live output cert — next steps and production window

Hi Diego,

Thanks again for the demo yesterday. We liked the streaming + function-calling flow — the ability to return structured JSON and trigger downstream order-of-operation tools is exactly what our triage team needs. Before we flip the switch in production we need a short checklist that confirms:

- schema stability for the structured output (primary/optional fields)
- acceptable latency percentiles for 99th/95th under our projected traffic
- what falls back to the synchronous model if function/tool calls fail
- audit/logging evidence (KV cache and token-level traces) for compliance reviews

Can you send a short certification roadmap and any sample schema examples we can give to our integration team? Paul (copied) will own procurement sign-offs once the SOW and verification session are scheduled.

We prefer a validation window the week of June 12 — can you propose 2x 60-minute slots (PST) where we can validate streaming + tool-calls with our test harness?

Thanks,
Elena Ruiz
Director of Platform Engineering
WellPoint Health

Elena — really glad the demo resonated. Attached is a concise "Live Output Certification Roadmap" (PDF) and a small schema-examples.json with three canonical payloads we use in validation. High level plan below; see attachments for the checklist matrix and drive links.

Summary plan (proposed):
1) Pre-validation (this week) — share schema examples and run a quick contract test against your harness to flag required vs optional fields. (Goal: freeze schema for validation)
2) Validation session (60–90 mins) — run through 3 live scenarios: normal streaming, tool-call success path, tool-call failure & fallback. Collect latency p99/p95 and token-level traces.
3) Certification report (2 business days) — we deliver the verification artifact (pass/fail matrix, token/policy logs, and recommended routing/quantization knobs).
4) Production checklist sign-off — procurement & legal countersign SOW; we schedule an enablement cutover with canary traffic.

Proposed validation slots (PST):
- Tue Jun 13, 10:00–11:30
- Wed Jun 14, 14:00–15:30

Next steps for you: confirm preferred slot and whether your test harness can ingest sample schema-examples.json (attached).

I've looped in Monica (CS) to coordinate logistics and Karthik (SE) to verify the schema mapping and runtime knobs.

Best,

Diego Fernandez
Customer Solutions Manager, Redwood Inference
